program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
                  (all-vals (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                       (map (lambda (c) (at g r c)) (range 0 (cols g))))
                                     (range 0 (rows g))))
                  (rarest (first (sort-by objs
                                          (lambda (o)
                                            (count-if (lambda (v) (= v (obj-color o)))
                                                      all-vals))))))
             (crop-object g rarest)))))
